selection_rule: Choose raw or EMA by two-development-seed mean IC4 J with ADE and FDE4 both reported. Freeze the recipe, then run all five predeclared model seeds with batch order fixed to 20260921. Do not treat development selection as confirmation.
seed_reporting_rule: Report every seed, mean, sample standard deviation, paired per-seed deltas, and paired confidence intervals. Never select or omit seeds by outcome.

baseline_roles.self: Interaction-necessity control using target history only.
baseline_roles.pool: N<=8 neighbor-access control without explicit graph or higher-order interaction modeling.
baseline_roles.strong_graph: Primary practical classical GNN baseline with the same N<=8 information budget.
baseline_roles.matched_johnson: Primary mechanism control sharing the Raj multi-order interface, temporal encoder, interaction projection, decoder, data, and training recipe; only the interaction operator changes.
baseline_roles.large_johnson: Higher-capacity classical higher-order control with the same N<=8 information budget.
baseline_roles.all_graph: Neighborhood-budget ablation only; not a primary Raj performance hurdle because it uses a different visible-neighbor budget.

fairness_rule: Primary claims compare Raj, Strong Graph, Matched Johnson, and Large Johnson under the same N<=8 input budget, dataset, split, target, history, horizon, state, training population, and common training recipe. AllGraph is reported only as a neighborhood-budget/task-definition ablation.
